title: Depth after hardwiring left inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $m+n$ input bits, and fix an assignment $y$ to its first $m$ inputs. The circuit obtained by hardwiring those inputs has depth at most $	ext{depth}(C)+1$.
